motion: The camera does not move. A light breeze moves the long grass. The survivors keep walking slowly out of the open blast doors and down the slope, one after another, squinting up at the bright grey sky, one shielding his eyes with his hand. The small grey delivery robot in the foreground rolls slowly and steadily towards the left edge of frame, leading them, its amber beacon glowing. The torn cloth hangs limp and low across its front wheels and does not lift. The robot keeps exactly its shape; nothing rises from it. Every person keeps their shape. The camera does not move.
